title: 7C end-of-unit quiz
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: Muscles and bones (7C); the particle model (7G)
source: Seeded from science/y7 lesson 25 (7C end-of-unit quiz (portal quiz))
intro: Covers lessons 17 to 31 of Muscles and bones (7C); the particle model (7G). Answer every question. For multiple choice, fill in one circle.

questions.q: Where does air go straight after the trachea?
questions.a: B) Bronchi. The trachea divides into two bronchi, one for each lung.

questions.q: When you breathe in, the pressure in your chest...
questions.a: B) falls. Volume increases, so pressure falls below the air outside and air flows in.

questions.q: Why are alveolus walls so thin?
options: So gases diffuse a short distance
questions.a: B) So gases diffuse a short distance. A short distance makes diffusion faster.

questions.q: Which chamber pumps blood to the body?
questions.a: C) Left ventricle. The left ventricle has the thickest wall and pumps blood to the body.

questions.q: Which vessel has valves?
questions.a: B) Vein. Veins carry low-pressure blood, so valves stop it flowing backwards.

questions.q: 21 beats in 15 seconds is...
questions.a: C) 84 bpm. 21 × 4 = 84 beats per minute.

questions.q: Which joint is a ball and socket?
questions.a: C) Hip. The hip moves in all directions: ball and socket.

questions.q: To straighten the arm, which muscle contracts?
questions.a: B) Triceps. The triceps at the back contracts and pulls the forearm straight.

questions.q: Which system delivers oxygen to the muscles?
questions.a: B) Circulatory. The circulatory system carries oxygen from the lungs to the muscles.

questions.q: Which state has a fixed volume but no fixed shape?
questions.a: B) Liquid. Liquids keep their volume but take the shape of their container.

questions.q: Why can liquids flow?
options: Particles can slide past each other
questions.a: B) Particles can slide past each other. Liquid particles touch but can move past each other.

questions.q: When ice melts, the particles...
options: gain energy and leave fixed positions
questions.a: B) gain energy and leave fixed positions. Heat gives particles energy to break out of their fixed positions.

questions.q: Diffusion is fastest in...
questions.a: B) a hot gas. Gas particles move fast, and faster when hotter.

questions.q: In this test the dependent variable is...
questions.a: B) time for colour to spread. We measure the time, so it is the dependent variable.

questions.q: What causes gas pressure?
questions.a: B) Particles colliding with surfaces. Gas pressure is the result of many particle collisions on a surface.

questions.q: Name the organ system that carries blood around the body.
questions.a: The circulatory system

questions.q: Gas exchange happens in the...
questions.a: Alveoli

questions.q: What comes after the bronchi?
questions.a: Bronchioles

questions.q: When breathing in, the diaphragm...
questions.a: Contracts and flattens

questions.q: Breathing in: chest volume...
questions.a: Increases
